title: That is my toy 😂
description:
That is my toy. Bubbles sits on a living room floor pointing at a golden retriever lying nearby chewing a baby toy, then looks into the camera, deadpan.

"That is my toy. Return it." — Bubbles

Bubbles the Baby CEO: A baby. A boardroom. Zero patience for meetings.
Follow for a new episode every day.
